briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race ahead as compute bottlenecks tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid escalating US-China tensions. Funding surges past $11B this quarter while regulatory scrutiny intensifies on export controls.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native video reasoning; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V3 matches GPT-4o performance at lower cost. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for NVIDIA Blackwell; Microsoft and xAI announce joint 100k H100 cluster in Texas; Saudi Arabia commits $4B to sovereign AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI-level system emerge from a Western or Chinese lab by 2028?
